India's Beauty Market to Reach $42 Billion by FY31

India's beauty and personal care market is projected to grow significantly, reaching an estimated $42 billion by the fiscal year 2031. A report indicates that by 2030, India will be the fourth-largest market globally in this sector. This growth signifies a substantial expansion for the industry within the country.
